title: REST and GraphQL entities: caching, pagination, filtering
summary: Expose objects and relationships and tune endpoints with caching, pagination, searching, and filtering.

items: Enable caching, pagination, searching, and filtering.

blocks.body: Well-designed endpoints need caching, paging, and filtering — all configurable in DAB.

terms.definition: A configured link between entities enabling nested queries.
Returning results in pages (e.g., first/after) to bound response size.

blocks.body: Expose tables, views, **stored procedures**, and **GraphQL relationships**. Configure **data caching**, **pagination**, **searching**, and **filtering** so clients fetch exactly what they need efficiently.

tips: DAB can expose stored procedures and relationships, not just tables.

blocks.body: Configure entity relationships plus caching, pagination, search, and filtering to build efficient REST/GraphQL APIs.
